description: Implementation of MobileAppBundleService for managing mobile app bundles, including CRUD operations, OAuth2 client updates, and related data handling within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: MobileAppBundleServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for managing mobile app bundles, including CRUD operations, OAuth2 client management, and event publishing within the platform.

methods.name: saveMobileAppBundle
methods.description: Validates and saves a MobileAppBundle, publishing a save event.

methods.name: updateOauth2Clients
methods.description: Updates OAuth2 clients associated with a mobile app bundle, adding new and removing old clients.

methods.name: findMobileAppBundleById
methods.description: Retrieves a mobile app bundle by its ID.

methods.name: findMobileAppBundleInfosByTenantId
methods.description: Fetches paginated info about mobile app bundles for a tenant, including OAuth2 clients.

methods.name: findMobileAppBundleInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info about a specific mobile app bundle, including OAuth2 clients.

methods.name: findMobileAppBundleByPkgNameAndPlatform
methods.description: Finds a mobile app bundle by package name and platform, ensuring platform is specified.

methods.name: deleteMobileAppBundleById
methods.description: Deletes a mobile app bundle by ID and publishes a delete event.

methods.name: deleteByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all mobile app bundles associated with a tenant.

methods.name: findEntity
methods.description: Finds an entity by ID, returning an optional.

methods.name: findEntityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds an entity by ID.

methods.name: deleteEntity
methods.description: Deletes an entity by ID, with optional force parameter.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type managed by this service, which is MOBILE_APP_BUNDLE.

methods.name: fetchOauth2Clients
methods.description: Helper method to fetch and set OAuth2 clients for a mobile app bundle info object.
